metadata.title: Tyrian — Legendary DOS Game (Next.js 16 + J-Dos)
metadata.description: Play classic 1995 Tyrian DOS game directly in your browser using J-Dos & Next.js 16. Includes OpenTyrian source showcase, ship hangar, OST jukebox player, and complete manual.

hero.subtitle: Epic Sci-Fi Space Combat Against MicroSol Megacorp
hero.description: Relive the legendary 1995 vertical scrolling shooter by Eclipse Software & Epic MegaGames. Powered by WebAssembly J-Dos emulation with smooth 60 FPS performance across all devices.

lore.title: TYRIAN UNIVERSE LORE
lore.subtitle: A chronicle of space espionage, corporate treason, and mysterious Zinglon mineral.
lore.microsolDesc: MicroSol is a massive galactic conglomerate controlling terraforming routes across star systems. Upon discovering Zinglon's infinite energy potential, MicroSol unleashed a lethal campaign to assassinate anyone with knowledge of the mineral.
lore.trentDesc: A talented terraforming reconnaissance pilot, Trent discovers the Zinglon anomaly on Planet Tyrian. Following the brutal assassination of his partner Buce Aldrich, Trent becomes the galaxy's most wanted target and must fight for survival.
lore.zinglonDesc: Zinglon is a rare living crystalline substance emitting micro-gravitational pulses. Integrated into ship reactors, Zinglon supercharges plasma cannons and generates limitless deflector shields.

source.title: OPEN TYRIAN REPOSITORY
source.subtitle: Explore the open-source C/SDL2 port of the legendary DOS classic Tyrian.
source.architectureDesc: OpenTyrian modularizes rendering for VGA 320x200 256-color modes, AdLib OPL2/OPL3 FM synthesis, and projectile/entity collision subsystems.
source.sourceEmbeddedDesc: The complete OpenTyrian source code is located in the /opentyrian directory in this repository as requested.

manual.title: PILOT FLIGHT MANUAL & SECRETS
manual.subtitle: Maneuver guidelines, generator calibration tactics, and legendary cheat codes.
manual.destructDesc: Type DESTRUCT in Tyrian's main menu to play the classic 2-player artillery tank battle game!
